findings.reason: following the followup dispatches the §6 acceptance re-measurement (which §7 exists to precede, on the same scarce quiet-node allocation) instead of §7, and the followups are the plan's sole record of the next step.
findings.text: f-araiid-004 is open and its `data-recommends-skill` and prompt dispatch `/reckon-build a-read-answers-inside-its-deadline §6`, but §6's done-when is unsatisfiable until a fix exists and the plan's own §6 comment (`c-s6-first-measurement-1012`) plus the new §7 state that §7 attributes the residual time first; a coordinator reading the followups list sees only §6

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — §7's base `d249200c7` and `main` resolve, `health-tool-latency/scripts/profile_reads.py` exists under health-review-1010, and the new comment's `#s6-first-measurement` anchor resolves to an id in the landed evidence page.
rubric_items.done_when: pass — §7's done-when names its base arm as the negative control and gates on report contents (base+head medians, kept .prof files, attribution table) that can fail; §6 keeps its base-revision control.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — §7 keeps every .prof dump and its report under the run's report directory, replacing the node-local /tmp loss it describes; §6's write path is likewise the run's own log directory.
rubric_items.naming: pass — §7 introduces no symbols; its commit shas and `all_debug` are evidence/partition anchors, not plan labels, and no ticket or version tag appears.
rubric_items.reasoning: pass — §7's stated cause (base arm on the shared fleet node, head-arm profile dumps lost) matches the run records, and its mechanism (one node, one frozen corpus, base+head, kept profs, top-five cumulative-time attribution) produces the report its done-when measures.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §7 carries one deliverable, the attribution of residual read time at base and head on one quiet node; §6 remains the single acceptance measure.
rubric_items.wiring: a finding — the plan's only open followup, f-araiid-004 (`/reckon-build a-read-answers-inside-its-deadline §6`), recommends §6, but the new §7 and §6's own comment place §7's attribution before any further work on §6.
